description: Walk a repository (local directory or shallow-cloned GitHub URL) and report the integration opportunities patchbay could build: webhook handlers with TODO/empty bodies, .env.example entries pointing at vendor APIs with no implementation, TODO/FIXME comments mentioning vendors, and vendor SDKs imported but barely used. Understands TypeScript/JavaScript (Express/Next/Fastify routes) AND Python (FastAPI/Flask routes, pass bodies, raise NotImplementedError). Returns a ranked list, each item with a ready-to-run prompt the agent can hand straight to build_connector. Instant, free (no LLM / sandbox), auditable regex-only output.

path.description: Absolute path to a repo directory on disk, or a GitHub URL (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> — shallow-cloned to a tempdir and scanned).

topN.description: How many top-ranked opportunities to return. Default 15.

name: scan_repo
title: Scan a repo for integration opportunities
